display_name: WiSig Full 源域中心与边缘等能量换方向及精确扣噪
description: Compare direct, frozen R69, both-region equal energy exact noise direction, and exact noise subtraction on the same 360 source V packets.
authorization: User requests paired LoRa/WiSig exact-noise and equal-energy interventions. Isolated source diagnostic only.

code.environment: N607 archived WiSig Native FIR runtime Python

data.version: Main split source V 25 MS/s, post_sync/noeq
data.representation: 256 complex samples at 25 MS/s, central 208 points and first/last 24 points for diagnostic intervention.
data.label_map_ref: Registered WiSig source V labels by physical ID
data.validation_ref: Frozen original native-FIR decisions and isolated receive reference panel

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only attribution with separate truth-last scoring of native practical views; no training or target access.

sources.role: Frozen R69 and direct waveform parity, frozen Main Tri-SIG-TIME 2026092701 reader

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact archived direct and R69 decisions for all 360 source IDs in all seven Full views.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Existing frozen WiSig reader, R69 and same-row source replay, no new checkpoint.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Four fixed source diagnostic arms. No selection, fitting or target path.

execution.gpu_policy: One eligible GPU with at least 12 GiB of memory, checked with shared workload.
execution.stop_rule: Fail downstream on source provenance, frozen decision or physical ID mismatch, incomplete coverage, or nonfinite waveform.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source label process after frozen coverage and reference IDs.

rows.method: Direct, frozen R69, both-regions norm-matched exact direction, both-regions exact additive subtraction.
rows.seed_notes: Uses the original reader model seed, fixed split, registered receive draw and source-panel subsample. Exact source reconstructor checkpoint identities are in checkpoint.sources.
rows.budget_ref: No training, fixed four modes and seven views.

notes: No target data. Freeze all source predictions before independently joining source labels.
Both oracle treatments preserve original R69 clean. Actual R69 edit norm measured separately in each native region.
Exact subtraction retains other simulator action including synchronization offsets. The same 256-point classifier sees all arms.
